_about: THE classification table for everything a restore can write. Default-deny: a path or key that is not listed here is EXCLUDED and the dry run says 'not restored: unknown item <name>'. Each row has exactly one class. excluded = never restored (with the reason and what to redo). data = harmless personal content that cannot act (comes back without a tick). runs = something that is read as instructions by a model, plays audio to callers, sends messages or calls, or changes trust or network destinations (listed by name, unticked by default, applied only when its tick is ticked). Order matters: the first row that matches wins. The docs section of docs/BACKUP.md is generated from this file (a test fails when they differ), and tests walk the real writers and fail when a store is not classified here.

scan._about: Every name the desktop's own code uses for a file or a folder under its data folder, and every name the Agent's page uses in its browser storage, mapped to the row that classifies it or to the reason it is not a store. A test reads the sources and fails when a name is not here, so a new store cannot be added without a decision.

agentModules.desktop/backup.ts: The Agent's half of the backup: it reads its storage to export it, and writes only what the desktop lists when a restore is applied.
agentModules.main.ts: Only asks the browser to keep its storage (navigator.storage.persist): it writes nothing.
agentModules.settings.ts: IndexedDB (database bot.computer, store kv): the Agent's settings.
agentModules.vfs/projects.ts: The private file system: the projects and the front desk.
agentModules.vfs/transfer.ts: Exports a project to a folder the person picks on their own disk (the File System Access API): it does not touch the Agent's storage.
